notes.title: An update on Neural Dominion's forthcoming demo.
notes.notes:
Hey Cyberheads!

We want to thank you for your incredible feedback on our invite-only demo. After careful consideration, we've decided to delay our public demo to ensure we have enough time to make the necessary fixes for a more polished and enjoyable experience for everyone. 

As a result, we won't be participating in the October Steam Next Fefst. Instead, we're preparing for a demo release in 2025. Our team is working hard to bring you the best experience possible in Technograd!

In the meantime, stay tuned for sneak peeks into Neural Dominion's gangs, their unique playstyles, and much more over the next few months. 

Thank you for your continued support and for being such a dedicated playerbase. We can't wait to share more of Neural Dominion with you!

-GamesBond Studios & Camlann Games
